domain: forensic adjudication of contradictory provenance claims about Compound's durable write channel — what the manifest globs actually reach, what contextfiles.Load actually reads back, and at what authority grade
axioms: A carrier claim is settled by tracing the write glob to the read path, not by weighing the rhetoric of either side.
Naming a carrier does not close a capability gap; the carrier must itself pass the grade/namespace/read-filter/expiry clauses.
An append-only channel with a reader and no remover is an authority ratchet.
primitives: authority grade at the point of read
failure_mode: Can indict the incumbent so thoroughly that it under-serves the tournament's actual candidate-selection question.
Risks treating a permitted-but-unused write path as an occurring failure.
